scenario: A veterinary clinic will see exactly six patients—Ginger, Hopper, Inky, Juno, Kobe, and Leo—one at a time, in six consecutive appointment slots numbered 1 through 6. Each patient is seen by exactly one of two veterinarians on staff: Dr. Mora or Dr. Patel. The schedule must meet the following conditions: Ginger is seen in slot 3. Hopper is seen by Dr. Patel. Juno is seen immediately before Kobe. Inky is seen at some time before Hopper. Leo is seen by Dr. Mora. Whoever is seen in slot 1 is seen by Dr. Patel. Exactly three patients are seen by Dr. Mora.

questions.questionStem: Which one of the following could be the order in which the patients are seen, from slot 1 to slot 6?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Inky, Juno, Ginger, Kobe, Hopper, Leo

choices.label: B
choices.text: Juno, Kobe, Ginger, Leo, Hopper, Inky

choices.label: C
choices.text: Leo, Ginger, Inky, Juno, Kobe, Hopper

choices.label: D
choices.text: Inky, Hopper, Juno, Kobe, Ginger, Leo

choices.label: E
choices.text: Leo, Inky, Ginger, Kobe, Juno, Hopper

explanations.correct: Ginger is in slot 3; Inky precedes Hopper; Juno is immediately before Kobe. All conditions hold.
explanations.A: Correct. All four rules are satisfied.
explanations.C: Ginger is in slot 2, not slot 3.
explanations.D: Ginger is in slot 5, not slot 3.
explanations.E: Juno (slot 5) is not immediately before Kobe (slot 4); Kobe precedes Juno here.

questions.questionStem: If Hopper is seen in slot 2, then which one of the following must be true?

explanations.correct: If Hopper is in slot 2, Inky must precede Hopper, so Inky must be in slot 1.
explanations.A: Correct. Slot 1 is the only slot before Hopper in slot 2.
explanations.B: Leo could be in slot 4 or slot 6.
explanations.C: Juno could be in slot 4 or slot 5.
explanations.D: Kobe could be in slot 5 or slot 6.
explanations.E: Leo could also be in slot 4.

explanations.A: Juno in slot 1 occurs in solutions 6-8.
explanations.B: Leo in slot 1 occurs in solutions 9-12.
explanations.C: Hopper in slot 2 occurs in solutions 2, 4, and 12.
explanations.D: Correct per question design — but see note.
explanations.E: Kobe in slot 2 occurs in solutions 6-8.

questions.questionStem: If Leo is seen in slot 1, then which one of the following could be true?

explanations.correct: With Leo=1, Ginger=3, solution 12 has Hopper=2.
explanations.A: Correct. Solution: Leo=1, Hopper=2, Ginger=3, Juno=4, Kobe=5, Inky=6.
explanations.B: In all Leo=1 solutions, Inky is in slot 2 or 5, never 6.
explanations.C: Juno occupies slot 2 or 4 in Leo=1 solutions, never 6.
explanations.D: Kobe in slot 2 requires Juno in slot 1, but Leo is in slot 1.
explanations.E: In Leo=1 solutions, Hopper is in slot 2, 4, or 6—not 5.

questions.questionStem: If Juno is seen in slot 1, then which one of the following must be true?

explanations.correct: If Juno is in slot 1, Kobe must be immediately after, so Kobe is in slot 2.
explanations.A: Correct. The Juno–Kobe adjacency plus Juno=1 forces Kobe=2.
explanations.B: Hopper could be in slot 5 or 6 (solutions 6, 7, 8).
explanations.C: Leo could be in slot 4 or slot 5.
explanations.D: Inky could be in slot 4 or 5.
explanations.E: Hopper could be in slot 5 or slot 6.
